subject: [hw] V34 -> D01: facts for FACTS.md (ion ioctl sub-commands/offsets, dlopen names, sec_drv callers, property values)
body:
Facts for FACTS.md from V34 (evidence: llvm-objdump --triple=thumbv8a disassembly of the phone s own objects, kernel headers; all [V] on this host unless marked).

A. ION custom ioctl, the vendor wrapper passes the kernel enum ION_CMDS as the middle argument and the sub-command in the first word of the struct (drivers/staging/android/mtk_ion/mtk/ion_drv.h: enum ION_CMDS SYSTEM=0/MULTIMEDIA=1/MULTIMEDIA_SEC=2; struct ion_mm_data / ion_sys_data put the union at offset 8 because it holds an unsigned long long):
  A1. libvcodec_utility.so eVideoMemAlloc 0x1809a: ion_custom_ioctl(fd, 1, &mm_data), mm_cmd = ION_MM_GET_IOVA = 8, handle at offset 8, module at 12; the dma phy_addr is read back as a 64-bit at struct offset 32 (0x1812e ldr r0,[sp,#0x58], struct based at sp+0x38).
  A2. libvpud_vcodec.so vdec_get_frame_buffer_msg 0xb17c: same command; phy_addr read at offset 32 (0xb206 ldr r0,[sp,#0x50], struct at sp+0x30).
  A3. libvpud_vcodec.so 0xafa0: ion_custom_ioctl(fd, 0 (SYSTEM), &sys_data), sys_cmd = ION_SYS_GET_PHYS = 1, handle at 8, phy_addr written at offset 12 and len at 16 (0xafe8 ldr r0,[sp,#0x74], struct at sp+0x68).
  A4. libvcodec_utility.so 0x17acc (secure alloc) and libvpud_vcodec.so 0xaf4a: ion_custom_ioctl(fd, 1, ...) with mm_cmd = ION_MM_CONFIG_BUFFER = 0 (security=1 coherent=1 / module=1 coherent=1), no output.
  A5. libvcodec_utility.so eVideoInvalidateCache 0x17cb2 and eVideoFlushCache 0x17dec: ion_custom_ioctl(fd, 0, ...) with sys_cmd = ION_SYS_CACHE_SYNC = 0 and sync_type 1/2 (invalidate/flush by range) or 7 (invalidate all).
  A6. Both ion_mmap call sites (utility 0x1803c, vpud_vcodec 0xb12a) pass 7 arguments: fd, addr=0, len, prot=3, then on the stack flags=1 (MAP_SHARED), share_fd, offset=0. The 7th argument is 32-bit (the callers zero only one word at slot 6).
  A7. ion_alloc (utility 0x17a5a) has 6 arguments: fd, len, align, heap_mask (0x40000 on the secure path), flags, handle*; ion_alloc_camera (0x17eb6) has 5: fd, len, align, flags, handle*.

B. dlopen arguments (all three are absent from the loaded set and every call site handles NULL): "AVCSecureVdecCA.so" and "HEVCSecureVdecCA.so" in libvpud_vcodec.so 0x9b68/0x9bac/0xa0d8/0xa11c; "/vendor/lib/libmtcloader.so" in libvcodec_utility.so 0x19c98, dlsym "change_policy", called with "thermal_policy_05", then dlclose.

C. sec_drv_base_check / sec_drv_info_update: the callers are libvcodec_utility.so drvb_fc 0x345e8 and drvb_f2 0x34638; both wrappers are void and discard the return value. The real callee is in the phone s libmtk_drvb.so (sec_drv_base_check 0x2768, sec_drv_info_update 0x2828) and re-signs a response buffer after mtk_drvb_basechk/platform_advchk, i.e. it needs the secure world. With no secure world the caller s own verifier takes its error path and returns 1 to a caller that discards it.

D. property values used by the codec objects, from the phone s own build.prop files [V]: ro.build.type=user and ro.vendor.have_aee_feature=1 (/system build.prop in gpu/build/baseband-recon-20261104/system-x/system/build.prop); ro.vendor.mtk_config_max_dram_size=0x800000000, ro.vendor.mtk_sec_video_path_support=1, ro.vendor.mtk_tee_gp_support=1, ro.vendor.mtk_trustonic_tee_support=1 (extracted /vendor build.prop gpu/build/cam-vendor-20261109/vfs/build.prop). The other 197 property-shaped strings in the five objects are absent on this phone (unset -> caller default). Full list + per-key reason in gpu/hwcodec/shim/n2shim_props.c, regenerable with shim/test_v34/gen_props.py.
